newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Apple down, Compaq seen off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Apple down, Compaq seen off.

text.p: Apple Computer Corp shares fell 11/16 to 13 preceding Thursday's U.S. market open, driven lower by news last night of the resignation of Chairman Gilbert Amelio.
Amelio, who took the job 17 months ago, resigned after the board became unhappy with Apple's performance, Apple said.

Compaq, another computer industry heavyweight, is expected to decline after reporting quarterly earings above Wall Street estimates but below informal "whisper number" forecasts that fueled a sharp rise in the shares in recent weeks.
Compaq finished NYSE trade last night at 121-1/8.

"Compaq is going to go lower. It was trading at 96 (in late June) and the run-up was on the expectation they were going to beat the (earnings estimate) number. They beat it by $0.09, but that was not enough," a trader said.
In pre-open trade Compaq fell to 120-7/8, traders said.
Early this morning Compaq reported second quarter earnings of $1.48 per share, excluding a charge, versus $0.96 a year earlier.
Earnings news also drove down shares of Seagate Technology Inc. The stock shed 1-5/16 to 37-3/4 before the market open, traders said.
